description.zh:
基线子项列表。
>调用[DescribeImageBaselineStrategy](~~DescribeImageBaselineStrategy~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The baseline items.

> You can call the [DescribeImageBaselineStrategy](~~DescribeImageBaselineStrategy~~) API to obtain the value of this parameter.

description.zh: 基线风险保留时长，单位是天。
description.en: The baseline risk retention period, in days.

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：

- **zh**：中文。
- **en**：英文。
description.en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese.

- **en**: English.

description.zh:
数据来源，为空时默认查询镜像基线策略。取值：
- **default**：镜像
- **agentless**：agentless
description.en:
The data source. If you do not specify this parameter, the operation queries image baseline strategies by default. Valid values:

- **default**: image

- **agentless**: agentless

description.zh:
基线检查策略ID。
>调用[DescribeImageBaselineStrategy](~~DescribeImageBaselineStrategy~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the baseline check strategy.

> You can call the [DescribeImageBaselineStrategy](~~DescribeImageBaselineStrategy~~) API to obtain the value of this parameter.
The name of the baseline check strategy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas save-image-baseline-strategy --baseline-item-list ak_leak --strategy-id 8639 --strategy-name default --lang zh --source agentless --image-vul-clean 90 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas SaveImageBaselineStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --BaselineItemList ak_leak --StrategyName default --ImageVulClean 90 --StrategyId 8639 --Lang zh --Source agentless
